title: Oats Upma
description: A quick, fibre-rich savoury porridge of rolled oats tempered like upma with mustard seeds, vegetables and peanuts.
steps: Dry roast the oats in a pan on medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant, then set aside.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard seeds and fry the peanuts until lightly golden.
Add curry leaves, onion and green chilli and sauté for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the carrot and the 250 ml of water with the salt and bring to a boil.
Stir in the roasted oats and cook on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander leaves.
